main_text.p: De Magistratu autem agit libro toto de Laicis: hoc enim nomine contu-meliosè & contra usum Scripturæ Sacræ (quæ expresse Magistratum à Laicis distinguit, qui בְּנֵי[?] 2. Chron. 35. 5. 7. vocantur) unctos Domini designat. Ita autem agit contra nos (nam quæ adversum Anabaptistas aut alios disputat, nos non tangunt) de Magistratu, ut non tractet aliâ de re, quàm de potestate seu jure & officio ejus in rebus Ecclesiasticis; quemadmodum etiam in aliis libris quibusdam eam materiam inspergit. Nos in præsentiarum sequuti filum & ordinem instituti nostri contra eum agemus, ita ut, quandoquidem hæc materia vulgò minus nota est, distin-ctè proponamus & ipsius doctrinam, & doctrinam Ecclesiarum Reformatarum, hancque quantum postulat necessitas & chartæ hujus angustia patitur, probemus ex verbo Dei, & contrariam doctrinam refutemus, aut indicemus, apud quos auctores

page.notes: The Hebrew phrase after "qui" is small and partly blurred; only its first word is roughly legible, so it is marked [?]. The printed hyphen after "distinguit" at the line end appears as a stray mark and is not kept. The word "Sacræ" is printed with a ligature that could be read as "Sacrç"; it is read as Sacræ. Some ink spots and stray marks in the margins are not printed text and are omitted.
